overallReview.summary:
Swapnil, your resume shows strong technical depth and clear ownership, with 7 of your 10 bullets already backed by hard performance metrics. Your work on the RAG agent pipeline and cutting database query latency from 850ms to 120ms gives recruiters immediate proof of your backend and AI engineering capabilities.

To make your profile even sharper, address the few spots where details fall short. Your DevSecOps project bullet currently reads as a plain tool list rather than an engineering accomplishment, several prominent skills lack supporting project context, and your extracted text shows contact details merged directly into your summary.

strengths.title: Clear Quantification of AI System Performance
strengths.description: Your RAG pipeline bullet couples specific architectural tooling (FastMCP) with dual outcomes: a 35% improvement in retrieval speed and a 38% decrease in support queries. This immediately demonstrates both technical execution and user-level impact.

evidence.originalText: Architected RAG agent pipeline integrating 9 tools using FastMCP protocol, resulting in 35% faster retrieval and 38% reduction in manual support queries.

strengths.title: Rigorous Evaluation and Quality Benchmarking
strengths.description: Highlighting a 170-query multi-modal benchmark with an accuracy increase from 72% to 94% signals thorough evaluation rigor, which is critical for senior AI engineering roles.

evidence.originalText: Conducted 170-query evaluation benchmark across multi-modal retrieval models, elevating answer accuracy from 72% to 94%.

strengths.title: Demonstrated Backend Latency Optimization
strengths.description: You clearly connect specific database and caching techniques (re-indexing and Redis read-aside caching) to an explicit p95 latency reduction from 850ms to 120ms.

issues.whyItMatters: Recruiters and hiring managers scanning your projects cannot tell what you personally engineered, automated, or monitored with these tools.
issues.recommendation: Rewrite the bullet using an active power verb to describe what you built, how Trivy and AWS Inspector were integrated into Jenkins, and what Grafana monitored.
issues.correctedText: Automated security scanning and infrastructure monitoring by integrating Jenkins, Trivy, AWS Inspector, and Grafana into a DevSecOps pipeline [ADD: pipeline scan duration or deployment cadence].

issues.correctedText: Delivered comprehensive medical-surgical care and administered physician-prescribed medications for [ADD: typical number of patients per shift] patients.
metricDiscoveryQuestions: What was your standard nurse-to-patient ratio on the medical-surgical ward (e.g., 1:5, 1:6)?
How many patient beds was the medical-surgical unit equipped with in total?

evidence.originalText: Responsible for taking care of patients in the medical-surgical ward and administering medications as per doctor instructions.

issues.title: Supportive phrasing weakens clinical procedural ownership
issues.diagnosis: The phrasing 'Helped with wound dressing, IV cannulation, and post-operative care' uses supporting language ('Helped with') rather than claiming direct clinical execution.
issues.whyItMatters: IV placement, complex wound management, and post-surgical monitoring are core nursing competencies. Framing them as assistance can suggest you were shadowing rather than independently executing these procedures.
issues.recommendation: Use strong clinical action verbs such as 'Administered', 'Executed', or 'Managed' to clearly reflect your procedural autonomy.
issues.correctedText: Administered post-operative care, sterile wound dressings, and peripheral IV cannulations for medical-surgical patients.
metricDiscoveryQuestions: What types of surgical cases or wound complexities did you routinely manage (e.g., abdominal, orthopedic)?
How many IV placements or dressing changes did you perform across an average shift?

evidence.originalText: Helped with wound dressing, IV cannulation, and post-operative care for patients.

issues.title: Career objective phrasing replaces professional clinical positioning
issues.diagnosis: The summary closes with an outdated objective statement: 'To obtain a position as a Registered Nurse in a reputed hospital where I can utilize my clinical skills...'.
issues.whyItMatters: US recruiters scan summaries for what you offer (years of experience, primary clinical environments, core strengths) rather than what you seek from the employer.
issues.recommendation: Replace the objective sentence with a professional profile summary highlighting your years of medical-surgical nursing experience, patient assessment strengths, and active BLS/ACLS credentials.
